reading: This is a retro CRT/terminal-style landing page: an inset bordered terminal window with a dotted title bar and "tty1" label, a glowing "BOOT_" heading with a blinking cursor and scanline stripes, two blocks of green terminal-style text (a 4-line boot log with OK chips on the left, and an ASCII box-drawing info card on the right), and two square-cornered buttons ("RUN DEMO" outline, "BUY $49" filled). All copy, colors, dimensions and effects come directly from the user's typed notes, which take priority over the squiggly placeholder strokes.
